endorsements.name: Oleg Kupreev
endorsements.label: Huawei - From China with Love
endorsements.description: 3G/4G networks are getting popular more and more these days. Most of users nowadays have USB 3G/4G modems – they’re small, easy-to-use and pretty cheap. That’s why we started this research. The main idea of it – find an opportunity to infect as much as possible.

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process.
